title: 🤯 US Bought HALF a Continent for 4 Cents an Acre! #Shorts

subtitles.en: In 1803, American diplomats went to Paris just to buy a single city accidentally walked away with half a continent.
subtitles.zh: 1803 年，美國外交官前往巴黎原本只是想買下一座城市，結果卻意外帶走了半個大陸。

subtitles.en: Napoleon Bonaparte dreamt of building a colossal French empire right in the heart of North America.
subtitles.zh: 拿破崙·波拿巴曾夢想在北美洲的心臟地帶，建立一個龐大的法蘭西帝國。

subtitles.en: That entire dream relied on one hugely profitable sugar island, Saint-Domingue, modern-day Haiti.
subtitles.zh: 這整個美夢，全都仰賴一座利潤極其豐厚的產糖島嶼——聖多明哥，也就是現今的海地。

subtitles.en: But the enslaved people of Haiti launched a ferocious revolution, shattering French control.
subtitles.zh: 但海地受奴役的人民發起了一場猛烈的革命，徹底粉碎了法國的統治。

subtitles.en: To make matters worse, yellow fever wiped out thousands of French troops sent to retake the colony.
subtitles.zh: 更雪上加霜的是，黃熱病奪走了數千名被派去奪回殖民地的法軍性命。

subtitles.en: Without Haiti, Napoleon's American Empire collapsed. He was broke, and a new war with Britain was looming.
subtitles.zh: 失去了海地，拿破崙的美洲帝國隨之瓦解。當時他缺錢用，而與英國的新戰爭又迫在眉睫。

subtitles.en: Meanwhile, President Thomas Jefferson desperately needed control of New Orleans to secure American trade.
subtitles.zh: 與此同時，湯瑪斯·傑佛遜總統迫切需要掌控紐奧良，以確保美國的貿易順暢。

subtitles.en: Jefferson sent envoys to Paris with $10 million, hoping to buy just the city of New Orleans.
subtitles.zh: 傑佛遜派特使帶著一千萬美元前往巴黎，希望能只買下紐奧良這座城市。

subtitles.en: Desperate for cash, Napoleon stunned them by offering the entire Louisiana Territory for 15 million.
subtitles.zh: 急需現金的拿破崙提出了以一千五百萬美元出售整個路易斯安那領地，讓他們大為震驚。

subtitles.en: The US signed immediately, doubling the size of the nation for a bargain price of just 4 cents an acre.
subtitles.zh: 美國隨即簽約，以每英畝只要四美分的划算價格，讓國土面積整整翻了一倍。
